title: Newport Landing Whale Watching
specs: Year-round whale watching with seasonal sightings of Gray Whales, Blue Whales, Finback Whales, Dolphins, Sea Lions, and other marine wildlife
Tours travel along prime migration paths and coastal waters of Southern California
No high heeled, wedge, or hard soled footwear; flat rubber soled shoes or sandals recommended
Wheelchair accessible to dock but not fully ADA accessible; 3-step incline to board vessels; assistance required
Ultimate Whale Watching ages 5 and up
Group rates available for 20+ people with pricing varying by group size and season
Private charters available for company events with vessels from 40 to 149 passengers

blurb: Guests take 2 to 2.5 hour whale watching cruises on vessels ranging from 15 to 145 passengers. Tours travel along the coast to view whales, dolphins, sea lions, and other marine wildlife. Options include standard, luxury catamaran, ultimate RIB vessel, group rates, and private charters for companies and events.
extraNote: 24 hour cancellation policy for full refund or reschedule · No refunds for no wildlife sightings; 50% off return ticket if no whales seen; $7 return ticket if no marine mammals seen · Reservations require payment to secure tickets · Reservations held until 30 minutes prior to departure; tickets may be resold after that · Check in at 309 Palm Street Suite A or 400 Main Street, Newport Beach, CA 92661 depending on vessel and cruise time · Year round
